blocks.text: Night. An encampment of Moroccan troops on the edge of the desert. Watch-fires, with SOLDIERS resting by them.

lines: Gone is the Emperor’s milk-white charger!
The Emperor’s sacred robes are stolen!
A hundred stripes upon the foot-soles
For all who fail to catch the robber!

blocks.text: The troopers mount their horses, and gallop away in every direction.
